content.title: Photo gallery from Michigan’s national championship win over UConn – Macomb Daily
content.text: Skip to content Michigan forward Yaxel Lendeborg celebrates after defeating UConn in the NCAA college basketball tournament national championship game at the Final Four, Monday, April 6, 2026, in Indianapolis. (AP Photo/Abbie Parr) By Matthew Mowery | mmowery@medianewsgroup.comPUBLISHED: April 7, 2026 at 1:38 AM EDT Getting your Trinity Audio player ready...Michigan beat Connecticut, 69-63, in the NCAA Division I men’s basketball championship game Monday night to win the Wolverines’ first national title since 1989. The win gives the Big Ten national champs in men’s basketball (U-M), women’s basketball (UCLA) and football (Indiana), just the second time a single conference has captured all three since women’s hoops was added as an NCAA sport in 1981-82. Here are all the sights from Indianapolis: Michigan head coach Dusty May celebrates by cutting down the net after defeating UConn in the NCAA college basketball tournament national championship game at the Final Four, Monday, April 6, 2026, in Indianapolis.
